text: In reservoir computing, what is actually trained, and what property must the reservoir satisfy?
choices: Only a linear readout is trained; the reservoir must satisfy the echo-state property (fading memory, spectral radius rho < 1)
All recurrent weights are trained by backpropagation-through-time; rho must exceed 1
Only the input weights are trained; the readout is fixed at random
The reservoir is trained while the readout is fixed
explanation: A reservoir fixes the high-dimensional nonlinear recurrent network at random and trains only the linear readout by ridge regression; the echo-state property (spectral radius rho < 1) guarantees fading memory. This turns fabrication variation into the network itself. Options 1 and 3 wrongly train the reservoir, and option 2 reverses which part is learned.
